# The two that were fixed after a fixture found them

**THE_RELEASE_DECISION_IS_CARRIED_FORWARD** — Compared against S.RELEASE_DECISION until fixture E-02 showed it was validating the register against the object it was copied from.

**THE_PAGE_BUDGET_STAYS_WITHIN_THE_RENDERER_CAPACITY** — Compared against MAX_LINES_PER_PAGE until fixture S-11 showed a raised budget made every page 'fit' by definition.

**EVERY_APPENDIX_PAGE_HOLDS_AT_MOST_TWO_PANELS** — Compared pages built from PANELS_PER_PAGE against PANELS_PER_PAGE until fixture A-01 raised the constant to 3 and the gate raised with it.

**EVERY_FROZEN_PANEL_STATE_IS_IN_THE_APPENDIX_DECK** — The deck was compared only with the page plan that generated it until fixture A-03 deleted a state and both sides agreed it was never there.

# The one that shares a helper, and why that is acceptable here

**EVERY_MODEL_BLOCK_APPEARS_IN_THE_DECK** — Both sides come from the model, but the OBSERVED side has made a round trip through python-pptx and back off disk. The gate proves the writer did not drop or mangle content, which is its only purpose. It is not a content-correctness oracle and is not treated as one — correctness is covered by SOURCE_STRINGS_ARE_VERBATIM against the extract.

- filtered-population named-membership and delta assertions (18 closed populations, t04_predicate_audit_v1)
